notes.title: Ailuri V0.9.3 Update
notes.content:
New level has been added! We have been receiving valuable feedback and reports. So, as a thank you, we have added an extra level to playtest. W1L5 has been added to the game. You'll need to beat W1L4 to get it.

We'd also like to request players to try out the 2 Player Co-Op!

tags.feature: - W1L5 has been added to the game.

notes.title: Ailuri V0.9.3 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Checks after selecting the 'clear game data' option or when leaving the options menu with unsaved changes
[*] Fixed a small number of bugs related to menu navigation
[*] A variety of art changes that the programmer doesn't fully understand but is sure are there.
[*] Fixed a bug where platforms in W1L10 wouldn't correctly respawn after restarting.
[/list]

From the Ailuri Team, a huge thanks to everyone who's taken the time to submit a bug report, every single one is appreciated!

notes.title: Ailuri V0.9.2 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we have some more fixes for this patch. 

[list]
[*] Some terrain and visual fixes to W1 L3
[*] UI updates for the Main Menu
[*] Small visual surprises in W1 L5's nest scene with Kakilea!
[*] Fixed a bug where the W1L10 Boss would stop moving
[*] Fixed a bug where the end-level upgrade screen would become unresponsive to controller input
[*] Fixed a bug regarding enemies facing their targets before attacking
[*] Fixed a bug regarding moving platforms not full resetting
[*] Fixed a bug where a lack of 'air time' would result in Ailuri instantly dying
[*] And a bunch of other, more minor, bug fixes.
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where the W1L10 Boss would stop moving
- Fixed a bug where the end-level upgrade screen would become unresponsive to controller input
- Fixed a bug regarding enemies facing their targets before attacking
- Fixed a bug regarding moving platforms not full resetting
- Fixed a bug where a lack of 'air time' would result in Ailuri instantly dying

notes.title: Ailuri V0.9.1 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when players attempted dash while climbing when dashing was disabled
[*] Fixed an incorrect controller scheme with Playstation Controllers
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when purchasing the Grapple Attack Upgrade
